featured_reviews.name: Dhruv Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review Date : 16th August, 2024

I am a 10th passout (87%) from this school. I’ve been studying here from Jr. KG up to class 10. The school provided a great learning experience before the pandemic. However, post-pandemic, there have been some changes that affected my experience.
While the earlier years had excellent teachers and a supportive environment, frequent changes in teachers in later years impacted the continuity of learning.The classrooms could benefit from some updates, and free access to the library would enhance the learning experience.
Additionally, the sports options are somewhat limited, and the costs for camps and picnics might be a bit high for some families.
(The SSC board curriculum has areas that could be improved, and considering a shift to CBSE (it used to be) might address some of these concerns)

Overall, the school continues to offer a good education, there are opportunities for improving the overall experience for students.

featured_reviews.name: Premjit Thakur 2727
featured_reviews.review_text:
The college offers a positive learning environment with good infrastructure and supportive faculty. The Zoology Department is well-organized, with knowledgeable teachers who focus on both theory and practical learning. Overall, it provides a strong academic foundation and encourages student growth.

Dr. Aparna Ghadi ma'am makes Zoology come alive in class. Her explanations of complex topics like genetics, physiology, and evolution are always clear and well-structured. She’s approachable, encourages questions, and genuinely cares whether students understand the concepts. Her practical sessions are thorough and she ensures we know the ‘why’ behind every experiment. One of the most dedicated and inspiring professors in the department.

Prof. Dheeraj Chavan sir’s lectures are engaging and full of real-life examples that make Zoology easy to remember. He has a great command over ecology, biodiversity, and animal behavior, and his passion for the subject is contagious. He motivates students to think beyond textbooks and take interest in research and field work. Very supportive during exams and project work. A mentor in the true sense.

Dr. Shivnetra Ma'am taught us in SYBSc and she’s one of the kindest teachers I’ve had. Super friendly and you can ask her anything without hesitation. She helped me not only with Botany doubts but also gave good advice when I was stressed about studies. Made the subject easy and enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Royal Showcase event held at our college was a memorable and vibrant occasion that highlighted the creativity, talent, and teamwork of the students. The event was well-organized and reflected the spirit of hospitality and professionalism expected from students of the hotel management field.
The atmosphere of the event was truly grand and lively. The venue was beautifully decorated with elegant themes that gave a royal and luxurious feel to the entire setup. The arrangement of lights, table settings, and stage decorations created an impressive ambience and attracted the attention of everyone present. It felt like attending a professional hospitality event rather than a regular college function.
One of the most impressive aspects of the Royal Showcase was the presentation of food and beverage service. Students demonstrated their practical skills by showcasing different styles of service, table layouts, and hospitality techniques. The table setups were neat, well-planned, and creatively designed. It clearly reflected the training and effort put in by the students.
The food section was also very impressive. A variety of dishes were displayed and prepared with great attention to presentation and taste. The plating was creative and visually appealing, which is an important aspect of culinary arts. The aroma and display of the food items made the event even more enjoyable for the guests.
Another highlight of the event was the teamwork and coordination among the students. Everyone performed their duties professionally, whether it was service, food preparation, hosting guests, or managing the event. Their discipline and dedication were clearly visible throughout the showcase.
The event was not only entertaining but also educational and inspiring. It gave students practical exposure to real hospitality event management and helped them gain confidence in their skills. It also allowed them to display their knowledge of food production, food and beverage service, and event organization.
Overall, the Royal Showcase was a grand success. It provided a platform for students to showcase their talent, creativity, and professional abilities. The event was enjoyable, well-managed, and left a lasting impression on everyone who attended it. Such events are very valuable for students as they help in developing practical knowledge and preparing them for the hospitality industry.
